title: Mythora
description: Mythora is a CityBuild Minecraft server where players build, trade, and progress through jobs and quests.
body:
# 🌍 Mythora – German Minecraft Server

**Mythora** is a German Minecraft Java server focused on building, economy, and community gameplay. Play with others, create your own projects, and progress through different features on the server.

### 🏗️ Build & Create
Build your own bases, towns, or large projects and shape the world together with other players.

### 💰 Economy System
Earn money through different activities, trade with other players, and use the auction house to buy or sell items.

### 🎯 Progress & Features
Complete quests, earn rewards, and unlock new possibilities while playing on the server.

### 👥 Community
Join an active community, play with friends, and collaborate on big builds and projects.

### 🌎 Different Worlds
Explore multiple worlds including areas for building and gathering resources.


✨ **Join Mythora and start your adventure!**
